name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Tracing with Heterogeneous Refraction
aliases: Real-time GPU Ray Tracing with Volumetric Effects
definition: A real-time GPU ray tracing method that represents volumes as a sparse voxel octree and bends light through see-through objects with spatially varying indices of refraction.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Tracing with Heterogeneous Refraction is a real-time GPU method that bends light through volumes by storing per-voxel optical properties to enable refraction at every boundary, unlike standard approaches treating volumes as homogeneous.
